trail.text: Investigating the spike — orders is showing major distress with callers affected, so I'm tracing cause versus victim.
Orders looks like the epicenter rather than a downstream victim — now checking timing and remaining services to confirm.
I've ruled out healthy dependencies — now gathering final timing evidence to rank the impacted services.

causes.reasoning: Orders memory tripled instantly (328M to ~916M) with simultaneous CPU-system surge, memory failures, errors and latency, while its DB is healthy, indicating primary resource exhaustion.
Front-end shows only tail-latency inflation (p99 0.09 to 1.8s) starting at 13s after orders errors at 5s, consistent with downstream caller blocked by orders.
Node disk writes surged 14x (6.9k to 97k) ramping after orders memory jump, consistent with host-level spillover from orders pressure.
Shipping shows modest latency increase starting at 64s, well after orders onset, suggesting secondary queueing victim.
Carts p99 latency rose 5x starting at 33s after orders failure, indicating propagated slowdown not origin.
